articles.summary: West Central Tribune, Willmar, Minn.: Fraud, paid leave on western Minnesota voters' minds at legislative town hall. Concerns about fraud, Minnesota's new paid leave law, and the transfer of the Upper Sioux Agency State Park were the top issues as state legislators Sen. Gary Dahms, R-Redwood Falls, and Rep.
